summary: SVG rasterization to PNG using a headless Playwright/Chromium renderer: accepts SVG content via HTTP POST (raw body or JSON) or CLI and returns PNG bytes. Supports optional output width and background color via request headers. Runs as a standalone microservice on port 8002. Also provides batch directory conversion and single-file CLI conversion commands.

evidence.claim: POST /convert accepts SVG content (raw body or JSON) and returns PNG bytes via Playwright/Chromium rendering
POST /convert supports X-Output-Width and X-Background request headers for rendering customization
GET /health returns a HealthResponse JSON for liveness probing of the svg-to-image microservice
svg-to-image convert CLI converts a single SVG file or stdin to a PNG file using Playwright/Chromium
svg-to-image convert-batch CLI converts all SVG files in a directory to PNGs, writing alongside or to a specified root
svg-to-image serve CLI starts the FastAPI server on port 8002 (default) for POST /convert requests

invariants.statement: All rendering is performed by a headless Playwright/Chromium instance, not a server-side SVG library
The microservice runs on port 8002 by default
POST /convert returns image/png bytes directly, not a JSON wrapper

scenarios.name: convert SVG via HTTP
scenarios.given: SVG content as request body with optional X-Output-Width header
scenarios.then: PNG bytes are returned with image/png content-type

scenarios.name: batch convert directory
scenarios.given: A directory containing multiple SVG files
scenarios.when: svg-to-image convert-batch is invoked with the input directory
scenarios.then: Each SVG is rendered to a PNG written alongside it or to a specified root directory

scenarios.name: single file CLI conversion
scenarios.given: A single SVG file or stdin stream
scenarios.then: A PNG file is written to the specified output path

rebuild_decisions.name: Rasterization engine
options: Server-side SVG library such as cairosvg or librsvg
